titulo: Deadly strikes on Ukrainian cities after Zelenskyy warns of ‘massive’ Russian attack
cuerpo: Children among the dead across Kryvi Rih, Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava after wave of ballistic missile launches Russian air strikes killed at least 13 people in Ukraine on Thursday, including one in Kyiv, as attacks that extended as far ⁠as the western city of Lviv forced neighbouring Poland to scramble ​fighter jets to secure its airspace. A missile strike killed at least six people including two girls aged 5 and 12 in Kryvyi Rih, a city in central Ukraine, the head of its military administration said. The Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, warned the country hours in advance of Moscow launching the massive attack. Continue reading...
